title: The magic of truth and lies (and iPods)
speaker: Marco Tempest

sentences.en: So the type of magic I like, and I'm a magician, is magic that uses technology to create illusions.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢的魔术类型，而且我是一名魔术师，是利用技术创造幻象的魔术。

sentences.en: So I would like to show you something I've been working on.
sentences.zh: 所以我想向你们展示我一直在做的一些事情。

sentences.en: It's an application that I think will be useful for artists -- multimedia artists in particular.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个对艺术家——尤其是多媒体艺术家——有用的应用程序。

sentences.en: It synchronizes videos across multiple screens of mobile devices.
sentences.zh: 它可以在移动设备的多个屏幕上同步视频。

sentences.en: I borrowed these three iPods from people here in the audience to show you what I mean.
sentences.zh: 我向观众借了这三台 iPod，向你们展示我的意思。

sentences.en: And I'm going to use them to tell you a little bit about my favorite subject: deception.
sentences.zh: 我将用它们来告诉你一些我最喜欢的主题：欺骗。

sentences.en: (Music) One of my favorite magicians is Karl Germain.
sentences.zh: （音乐）我最喜欢的魔术师之一是卡尔·杰曼。

sentences.en: He had this wonderful trick where a rosebush would bloom right in front of your eyes.
sentences.zh: 他有一个绝妙的把戏，让一朵玫瑰花就在你眼前绽放。

sentences.en: But it was his production of a butterfly that was the most beautiful.
sentences.zh: 但他创造的蝴蝶是最美丽的。

sentences.en: (Recording) Announcer: Ladies and gentlemen, the creation of life.
sentences.zh: （录音）播音员：女士们、先生们，生命的创造。

sentences.en: (Applause) (Music) Marco Tempest: When asked about deception, he said this: Announcer: Magic is the only honest profession.
sentences.zh: （掌声）（音乐）Marco Tempest：当被问及欺骗时，他是这样说的： 播音员：魔法是唯一诚实的职业。

sentences.en: A magician promises to deceive you -- and he does.
sentences.zh: 魔术师许诺要欺骗你——他确实做到了。

sentences.en: MT: I like to think of myself as an honest magician.
sentences.zh: MT：我喜欢将自己视为一个诚实的魔术师。

sentences.en: I use a lot of tricks, which means that sometimes I have to lie to you.
sentences.zh: 我使用了很多技巧，这意味着有时我不得不对你撒谎。

sentences.en: Now I feel bad about that. But people lie every day.
sentences.zh: 现在我对此感到难过。但人们每天都在撒谎。

sentences.en: (Ringing) Hold on. Phone: Hey, where are you?
sentences.zh: （铃声响起）等一下。电话：嘿，你在哪里？

sentences.en: MT: Stuck in traffic. I'll be there soon.
sentences.zh: MT：堵车了。我很快就会到。

sentences.en: You've all done it. (Laughter) (Music) Right: I'll be ready in just a minute, darling.
sentences.zh: 你们都已经做到了。 （笑声）（音乐）右：我马上就准备好了，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Center: It's just what I've always wanted.
sentences.zh: 中心：这正是我一直想要的。

sentences.en: Left: You were great. MT: Deception, it's a fundamental part of life.
sentences.zh: 左：你太棒了。 MT：欺骗，这是生活的基本组成部分。

sentences.en: Now polls show that men tell twice as many lies as women -- assuming the women they asked told the truth.
sentences.zh: 现在的民意调查显示，男性说谎的次数是女性的两倍——假设他们询问的女性说的是真话。

sentences.en: (Laughing) We deceive to gain advantage and to hide our weaknesses.
sentences.zh: （笑）我们通过欺骗来获得优势并隐藏我们的弱点。

sentences.en: The Chinese general Sun Tzu said that all war was based on deception.
sentences.zh: 中国将军孙子说过，一切战争都是基于欺骗。

sentences.en: Oscar Wilde said the same thing of romance.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡·王尔德也对浪漫说过同样的话。

sentences.en: Some people deceive for money. Let's play a game.
sentences.zh: 有些人为了钱而行骗。我们来玩个游戏吧。

sentences.en: Three cards, three chances. Announcer: One five will get you 10, 10 will get you 20.
sentences.zh: 三张牌，三次机会。播音员：一五就可以得到10，10就可以得到20。

sentences.en: Now, where's the lady? Where is the queen?
sentences.zh: 现在，那位女士在哪里？女王在哪里？

sentences.en: MT: This one? Sorry. You lose. Well, I didn't deceive you.
sentences.zh: MT：这个？对不起。你输了。嗯，我没有骗你。

sentences.en: You deceived yourself. Self-deception. That's when we convince ourselves that a lie is the truth.
sentences.zh: 你欺骗了自己。自欺欺人。那是我们说服自己谎言就是真相的时候。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's hard to tell the two apart.
sentences.zh: 有时很难区分两者。

sentences.en: Compulsive gamblers are experts at self-deception.
sentences.zh: 强迫性赌徒是自欺欺人的专家。

sentences.en: (Slot machine) They believe they can win.
sentences.zh: （老虎机）他们相信自己能赢。

sentences.en: They forget the times they lose. The brain is very good at forgetting.
sentences.zh: 他们忘记了失去的时光。大脑非常善于遗忘。

sentences.en: Bad experiences are quickly forgotten. Bad experiences quickly disappear.
sentences.zh: 不好的经历很快就会被遗忘。不好的经历很快就会消失。

sentences.en: Which is why in this vast and lonely cosmos, we are so wonderfully optimistic.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在这个广阔而孤独的宇宙中，我们如此乐观。

sentences.en: Our self-deception becomes a positive illusion -- why movies are able to take us onto extraordinary adventures; why we believe Romeo when he says he loves Juliet;
sentences.zh: 我们的自欺欺人变成了一种积极的幻想——为什么电影能够带我们踏上非凡的冒险之旅；为什么当罗密欧说他爱朱丽叶时我们相信他？

sentences.en: and why single notes of music, when played together, become a sonata and conjure up meaning.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么音乐的单个音符一起演奏时会成为奏鸣曲并唤起意义。

sentences.en: That's "Clair De lune." Its composer, called Debussy, said that art was the greatest deception of all.
sentences.zh: 那就是《月光》。它的作曲家德彪西说，艺术是最大的欺骗。

sentences.en: Art is a deception that creates real emotions -- a lie that creates a truth.
sentences.zh: 艺术是一种创造真实情感的欺骗——一种创造真理的谎言。

sentences.en: And when you give yourself over to that deception, it becomes magic.
sentences.zh: 当你屈服于这种欺骗时，它就会变得神奇。

sentences.en: [MAGIC] (Music fades slowly) (Applause) Thank you. Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: [MAGIC]（音乐慢慢消失）（掌声）谢谢。非常感谢。

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
